2.23.17
Tablix.KeepTogether
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.KeepTogether element specifies whether the renderer attempts to render the entire
Tablix on one Page. This element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once.
If the Tablix.KeepTogether element is specified, its value MUST be a Boolean ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.2.2). A value of true specifies that the renderer attempts to render the entire tablix on one
page. If this element is not specified, its value is interpreted as false.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.KeepTogether element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.KeepTogether element.
 <xsd:element name="KeepTogether" type="xsd:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
